categories.main_business_segments: CIMC Enric Holdings Limited operates through three primary segments: Clean Energy, Chemical and Environmental, and Liquid Food. The Clean Energy segment focuses on equipment and integrated solutions for natural gas, hydrogen, and LPG storage, transportation, and processing. The Chemical and Environmental segment manufactures tank containers and provides related services, including medical equipment components. The Liquid Food segment specializes in stainless steel tanks, turnkey projects, and processing equipment for beer, distilled spirits, juice, and pharmaceuticals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in cryogenic storage, high-pressure and mid-pressure vessel manufacturing, and integrated engineering services. It develops hydrogen energy equipment including liquid hydrogen storage tanks and high-pressure cylinders, and utilizes digital twin and AI technologies for intelligent operation platforms. The Chemical and Environmental segment focuses on intelligent sensing, virtual simulation design, automated manufacturing, and IoT-enabled tank container monitoring. The Liquid Food segment emphasizes sustainable and energy-efficient processing technologies, including industrial complex distillation and solid-state fermentation systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include energy companies (PetroChina, Sinopec, China Energy Group), gas distributors (ENN Group, Shenzhen Gas), vehicle manufacturers (Sinotruk, Dongfeng Motor), shipping companies (Avenir LNG, Vitol International), chemical firms (BASF, DuPont, Wanhua Chemical), and beverage producers. The Clean Energy segment serves natural gas, hydrogen, and LNG industries; Chemical and Environmental serves tank container lessors, chemical logistics providers, and medical imaging equipment manufacturers; Liquid Food serves breweries, distilleries, juice producers, and biopharmaceutical companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with subsidiaries and production bases in China, the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, the UK, Canada, the USA, Singapore, and other regions. It has expanded sales offices in Africa, Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Middle East, with significant market penetration in China, Asia-Pacific, North America, Europe, and emerging markets such as Africa and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: CIMC Enric operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing key equipment for storage, transportation, and processing of clean energy and chemicals, and providing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services. It also offers integrated solutions and value-added services across the full lifecycle from project planning to operation management, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider in the clean energy industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in hydrogen energy, energy storage, multi-energy complementation, and digitalization including smart factories and intelligent service systems. It focuses on R&D for clean energy equipment, green methanol production, and low-carbon technologies, while advancing standards development and international market expansion. The company also invests in intelligent manufacturing, AI, IoT, and digital twin technologies to enhance operational efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of equipment such as LNG tanks, hydrogen storage vessels, tank containers, and liquid food processing equipment. Additional revenue streams include engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, integrated solutions, after-sales services, and value-added digital platforms. The company also earns from turnkey project delivery and long-term service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CIMC Enric is a leading integrated business service provider and key equipment manufacturer in the clean energy, chemical, and liquid food industries. It holds top global market shares in ISO liquid tank containers, cryogenic transportation vehicles, LNG receiving terminal storage tanks, and LNG bunkering vessels. The company is recognized as a technology leader with strong competitive advantages in hydrogen energy equipment and marine fuel tanks, competing with global and regional players in energy equipment manufacturing and engineering services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB 24.76 billion, a 4.8% increase year-on-year, with profit attributable to equity shareholders of RMB 1.09 billion. Total assets reached RMB 29.38 billion, and net assets increased by 5.9% to RMB 13.11 billion. The clean energy segment contributed 69.4% of total revenue and grew by 15.3%. The company maintains a stable gearing ratio of 22.8% and strong operating cash flow, reflecting steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CIMC Enric emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and innovative equipment combined with comprehensive, end-to-end integrated services across the clean energy lifecycle. Its competitive differentiation lies in technological leadership in hydrogen and LNG equipment, modular and intelligent manufacturing, digital and AI-enabled operation platforms, and a global marketing and service network. The company’s ability to provide customized, sustainable, and efficient solutions supports customers’ low-carbon transformation and operational excellence.
